title: 2024 Topps #268 Gabriel Moreno Arizona Diamondbacks Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Topps baseball trading card features Gabriel Moreno, a player from the Arizona Diamondbacks team. The card is part of the Base Set and has the card number 268. It is an original card manufactured by Topps in English language. 

The card is a single product and is not autographed. It is suitable for collectors of Major League (MLB) baseball cards. The card is not vintage and is from the modern era (1981-Now). The card features the player's name and the team logo. It is a great addition to any baseball trading card collection.
